description.en: Adds the household-wide presence and sleep condition cards Homey does not have ('Everyone is at home', 'Everyone is asleep', 'Everyone at home is asleep'), plus a vacation status per user with its own triggers, conditions, action and device. A user on vacation is left out of the 'everyone' cards, so those keep working for whoever is still around. Unofficial community app.

title.en: The last person at home goes to the status asleep

hint.en: Fires at the moment everyone who is at home has the status asleep, having not had it a moment earlier. Users who are away, on vacation, switched off in this app's settings, or disabled in Homey are ignored, so this still fires when somebody is out for the evening. It does not fire when the house is empty.

title.en: Nobody is on vacation any more

hint.en: Fires when the last person on vacation returns, so nobody in the household is away any longer. The counterpart to 'Everyone is on vacation'.
Fires at the moment the last counted user is marked as on vacation, so the whole household is away. Use it for holiday mode: heating down, presence simulation on.

Fires when a user's vacation status is cleared, whether by a Flow, their vacation device, the settings page, or automatically because Homey saw them come home. Choose 'Any user' to fire for everybody and read the User tag to tell who.
Fires when a user is marked as on vacation, by a Flow, their vacation device, or the app's settings page. Choose 'Any user' to fire for everybody and read the User tag to tell who.

True when every counted Homey user is marked as asleep. Users you switched off in this app's settings are ignored, and so are disabled accounts. A user whose sleep status has never been set counts as awake, because Homey does not know. If no users are counted at all, this card is false.

title.en: !{{Everyone is at home|Not everyone is at home}}

hint.en: True when every counted Homey user is marked as at home. Users you switched off in this app's settings are ignored, and so are disabled accounts. A user whose presence has never been set counts as not at home, because Homey does not know where they are. If no users are counted at all, this card is false.

title.en: !{{Everyone who is at home is asleep|Not everyone who is at home is asleep}}

hint.en: True when every counted user who is currently at home is also asleep. Users who are away are ignored, which is the difference from 'Everyone is asleep': this card can still be true while somebody is out. Users on vacation, users switched off in this app's settings, and accounts disabled in Homey are ignored. If nobody is at home this card is false, because there is no one whose sleep it could describe.

title.en: !{{Everyone is on vacation|Not everyone is on vacation}}

hint.en: True when every counted Homey user is marked as on vacation. Users switched off in this app's settings and accounts disabled in Homey are ignored. If there are no counted users at all this card is false.

title.en: !{{Nobody is on vacation|Someone is on vacation}}

hint.en: True when no counted Homey user is on vacation. Invert it to ask whether at least one person is away on vacation.

title.en: A user is !{{on vacation|not on vacation}}

hint.en: Checks the vacation status this app keeps for the chosen Homey user. Vacation is set by the 'Set vacation' action, by the user's vacation device, or on the app's settings page.
Marks a user as on vacation, or clears it. While a user is on vacation they are left out of the 'everyone' cards, so those keep working for whoever is still around.
